market.title: Built for today's housing market
market.subtitle: Two realities shape housing right now — and each one has a CYGEN path.

m1.title: The capital gap
m1.text: Many households can carry a monthly payment but cannot assemble the upfront capital a purchase demands. A partnership supplies that capital as co-ownership, not as debt.

m2.title: Value locked in homes
m2.text: People who already own and live in their home often hold most of their wealth inside it. Bringing the home to CYGEN turns that value into starting equity inside a transparent structure — with no cash-out.

m3.title: A different relationship
m3.text: Some people simply do not want to finance a home the conventional way. As Limited Partner you build ownership alongside a General Partner whose success is aligned with yours.

market.note: General market observations — not advice, and not a promise of any outcome.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: From your first enquiry to full ownership — every stage, in plain language.

stages.title: Apply
stages.text: Tell us which path you want — buy a home with CYGEN or bring your current home — and share the essentials. This form never asks for government ID numbers, account numbers, or income details.

stages.title: Review by a person
stages.text: A person at CYGEN reviews every application. Software can organise the file; it never makes the decision.

stages.title: Appraisal
stages.text: An independent appraisal establishes the home's value. This anchors the capital split between you and the fund.

stages.title: Structuring
stages.text: Together we set your initial equity share, size your Equity Payment once, and fix the COP — the cost of capital, a fixed rate that does not change.

stages.title: Closing
stages.text: The home is placed in a trust or SPV. You pay closing costs from your own cash; CYGEN does not fund them.

stages.title: Active partnership
stages.text: You live in the home and make your monthly Equity Payment. Part covers the COP; the rest builds your equity. Every six months the minimum payment is revised from the capital still outstanding.

stages.title: Equity completed
stages.text: When your equity reaches 100%, the home moves out of the trust or SPV and the partnership ends with you as the full owner.

concepts.title: COP — cost of capital
concepts.text: A fixed rate that is the fund's share of each Equity Payment. It is set once, at structuring, and it does not change.

concepts.title: Equity Payment
concepts.text: Your monthly payment, sized once at the start. Part covers the COP; the rest builds your equity in the home.

concepts.title: Minimum payment
concepts.text: The floor for your monthly payment. It is revised every six months from the capital still outstanding — not from a schedule written on day one.

concepts.title: Payment Halt
concepts.text: If life gets hard, your payments can pause for a period, on the conditions agreed in your partnership documents.

concepts.title: Reversed Equity
concepts.text: If the home's value falls, Reversed Equity can occur. What happens then is set out in your partnership documents before you sign — no surprises.

concepts.title: Exit and completion
concepts.text: You can exit the partnership early on the agreed path, or stay until your equity reaches 100% and the home is fully yours.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: The essentials of the CYGEN partnership, in plain language.

items.a: No. CYGEN is an equity partnership program. You are the Limited Partner who lives in the home; CYGEN's fund is the General Partner that supplies the capital. The home is held in a trust or SPV until your equity reaches 100%.

items.q: Who owns the home during the partnership?
items.a: The home is held in an independent trust or SPV. Inside that structure, you and the fund each hold an equity share. When your share reaches 100%, the home moves out of the structure and is fully yours.
COP stands for cost of capital. It is a fixed rate — the fund's share of each Equity Payment — set once at structuring and never changed afterwards.

items.q: How is my Equity Payment set?
items.a: Your Equity Payment is sized once, at the start of the partnership, from the capital the fund supplies and the fixed COP. Part of each payment covers the COP; the rest builds your equity.

items.q: Why does the minimum payment change every six months?
items.a: The minimum payment is revised from the capital still outstanding, not from a fixed schedule. As your equity grows and the outstanding capital shrinks, the minimum can come down.

items.q: What if I cannot pay for a while?
items.a: If life gets hard, a Payment Halt can pause your payments for a period, on the conditions agreed in your partnership documents. Talk to us early — a person handles these conversations, not software.

items.q: What happens if my home's value falls?
items.a: Reversed Equity can occur. What that means for you and for the fund is set out in your partnership documents before you sign, so there are no surprises later.

items.q: Can I leave the partnership early?
items.a: Yes. There is an agreed exit path, described in your documents. And if you stay, the equity-completion path ends with you as the full owner of your home.

items.q: Who decides whether my application is accepted?
items.a: A person at CYGEN reviews every application. Nothing is decided by software alone, and submitting an application never guarantees acceptance.

items.q: What is the difference between buying with CYGEN and bringing my home?
items.a: Buying with CYGEN means you pick a home and an initial equity share, and the fund supplies the rest. Bringing your home means the fund settles the existing financing, and you start with the equity your home already holds.

items.q: What costs do I pay at the start?
items.a: You pay the closing costs from your own cash. CYGEN does not fund closing costs, and cash-out is not offered on either path.

items.q: Can I switch between the two paths?
items.a: Yes. You can switch between buying with CYGEN and bringing your current home at any point until your application is submitted.

items.q: Do you promise approval or particular figures?
items.a: No. We never promise approval, rates, savings, or outcomes. Every figure on this site is illustrative; your actual structure is set out in your own partnership documents.

items.q: What information will you ask me for?
items.a: Our forms ask only for your contact details and which path you are considering. We never ask for government ID numbers, account numbers, or income details through this website.

disclosures.title: Disclosures
paragraphs: CYGEN is an equity partnership program, not a mortgage product. In a CYGEN partnership, the person who lives in the home is the Limited Partner and CYGEN's fund is the General Partner. The home is held in a trust or SPV until the Limited Partner's equity reaches 100%.
All figures on this website are illustrative. They are not an offer, a promise, or a projection of any outcome. The structure of any partnership is set out only in that partnership's own documents.

CYGEN does not promise approval, rates, savings, or outcomes. A person at CYGEN reviews every application; nothing is decided by software alone. Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance.

Home values can rise and fall. If a home's value falls, Reversed Equity can occur. Payment Halt, Reversed Equity, the exit path and the completion path are governed by each partnership's documents, which you should read carefully before signing.
Nothing on this website is legal, tax, or financial advice. Please consult your own advisors.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
paragraphs: We collect only the details you give us through our forms: your name, your email address or phone number, your preferred language, the path you are considering, and your message. For workshop registrations we also record which session you chose.

We use these details to reply to your enquiry and to manage workshop registrations. We do not sell your details, and we share them only with the service providers who operate this website, under confidentiality obligations.
Our forms never ask for government ID numbers, account numbers, or income details. Please do not send us such information through this website.
You may ask us at any time to see, correct, or delete the details we hold about you by writing through the contact form.
This notice is a draft and will be replaced by a full privacy policy reviewed by counsel.

terms.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: This website is provided by CYGEN Equities for general information. By using it you accept these terms of use.
The content of this website is informational only. It is not an offer, an invitation, or a commitment of any kind, and it does not create any partnership or other relationship.
All text, graphics, and the CYGEN wordmark on this site belong to CYGEN Equities. You may not reproduce them without written permission.
This website may link to other sites. We are not responsible for their content.
We may change these terms of use at any time; the version published here applies. Governing law and jurisdiction will be confirmed by counsel.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
paragraphs: We want everyone to be able to use this website. It is built to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA: text contrast of at least 4.5:1, visible focus indicators, keyboard-operable menus and accordions, semantic structure with one main heading per page, and respect for reduced-motion settings.
The site works in English and Spanish, and in dark and light themes that both meet the same contrast standard.
If anything on this site is hard for you to use, please tell us through the contact form. A person will read your message and we will fix what we can.
This statement is a draft and will be reviewed by counsel.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.intro: Five beliefs sit under everything CYGEN builds.

beliefs.title: Ownership over debt
beliefs.text: A home should be something you grow into owning, not something you owe on. Partnership aligns everyone around that single finish line.

beliefs.title: Plain words, always
beliefs.text: If a sentence needs a glossary, we rewrite the sentence. Figures are labelled illustrative, and the real ones live in documents you can actually read.

beliefs.title: A person decides
beliefs.text: Software can organise a file; it never decides one. Every application, every Payment Halt, every hard conversation gets a person.

beliefs.title: Aligned to 100%
beliefs.text: The partnership succeeds when the Limited Partner reaches full ownership. Anything that does not serve that outcome does not belong in the structure.

beliefs.title: Calm in hard moments
beliefs.text: Payment Halt and Reversed Equity exist because life is not a straight line. The rules for hard moments are written before they are needed.

impact.title: Social impact
impact.intro: What partnership-based ownership can change — and how we hold ourselves to it.

areas.title: Access to ownership
areas.text: The upfront capital gap keeps capable households out of ownership. A partnership exists to close that gap with co-ownership rather than more debt.

areas.title: Education in plain language
areas.text: Free workshops, open questions, and vocabulary that explains itself — the Equity Payment, the COP, the six-month revision — so people decide with understanding.

areas.title: Community partnerships
areas.text: We work with brokers, advisors, and community organisations that already serve future homeowners, and we keep their clients' consent ahead of any contact.

areas.title: Honest reporting
areas.text: We would rather say less and prove it. This page states our direction; results are published only when we can evidence them.

impact.note: No invented numbers: impact figures appear here only once they are real, reviewed, and dated.
